open_problems.problem: Determine structural branches and necessary/sufficient AS and Koszul conditions in seven-window data
Prove standard exhaustiveness or construct Q outside H / H outside S with the required primitive jumps
Complete index-preserving isomorphism classification after diagonal-twist normalization, including GL2 and special parameters

resume_point.next_action: Implement word-length/weight separated path spaces for i modulo7 and lengths0..5; compute quadratic dual dimensions and product pairing matrices for the diagonal and Ore regression examples, then impose rho_i=0/1 branches. Keep Koszul exactness as a separate obligation.
resume_point.obstacle: Finite Frobenius conditions do not by themselves establish Koszulity; feasibility of nonconstant rho patterns is unknown.
resume_point.do_not_repeat: Known diagonal regularity, the three diagonal-twist invariants, the explicit Ore dual and its two-class normalization are already proved.
